description: This file manages thread binding policies for channels, including configuration resolution, spawn policies, timeouts, and lifecycle management within a chat or messaging system.

methods.name: normalizeChannelId
methods.description: Normalizes a channel ID string by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: supportsAutomaticThreadBindingSpawn
methods.description: Checks if automatic thread binding spawn is supported for a given channel.

methods.name: requiresNativeThreadContextForThreadHere
methods.description: Determines if native thread context is required for the specified channel.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingPlacementForCurrentContext
methods.description: Resolves whether the current thread should be 'current' or 'child' based on channel and thread ID.

methods.name: resolveDefaultTopLevelPlacement
methods.description: Resolves the default top-level placement ('current' or 'child') for a channel.

methods.name: normalizeBoolean
methods.description: Converts a value to a boolean if it is of boolean type, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: normalizeThreadBindingHours
methods.description: Normalizes raw hours value to a finite number or undefined.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingIdleTimeoutMs
methods.description: Calculates idle timeout in milliseconds based on channel and session idle hours.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingMaxAgeMs
methods.description: Calculates max age in milliseconds based on channel and session max age hours.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingLifecycle
methods.description: Determines expiration time and reason for thread binding lifecycle based on activity and age.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingEffectiveExpiresAt
methods.description: Returns the effective expiration timestamp for a thread binding.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if thread bindings are enabled based on raw config values.

methods.name: resolveChannelThreadBindings
methods.description: Resolves thread binding configurations for a specific channel and account.

methods.name: resolveSpawnFlagKey
methods.description: Returns the spawn flag key ('spawnSubagentSessions' or 'spawnAcpSessions') based on spawn kind.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingSpawnPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the spawn policy for thread bindings for a given channel, account, and spawn kind.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingIdleTimeoutMsForChannel
methods.description: Resolves idle timeout in milliseconds for a specific channel and account.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingMaxAgeMsForChannel
methods.description: Resolves max age in milliseconds for a specific channel and account.

methods.name: resolveThreadBindingChannelScope
methods.description: Resolves the scope of thread binding configuration for a channel and optional account.

methods.name: formatThreadBindingDisabledError
methods.description: Formats an error message indicating thread bindings are disabled for a channel.

methods.name: formatThreadBindingSpawnDisabledError
methods.description: Formats an error message indicating thread spawn is disabled for a channel and spawn kind.
